item.title: Sic Mundus #1: The Neural Network as Oracle — AI and Religion
item.description: First episode of the Sic Mundus podcast. How large language models work, why they resemble oracles, and how they are being integrated into religious life.

item.title: SPEECH Podcast (Litres): What Is Religion and How to Create One
item.description: Interview for the Litres podcast on the nature of religion, quasi-religions, transhumanism, AI in spiritual life, and what it actually takes to start a new religion.

item.title: Pascal's Wager Podcast: What Does It Mean to Be a Rational Person?
item.description: Guest appearance on the Pascal's Wager podcast — on rationality, science, astrology, and thinking.
